notes: Sounds: hold a .wav under EXTRAS > SFX to make it this device's CRITICAL HIT, POISON, KNOCKOUT or FANFARE; an unbound event plays its default file, or any .wav whose name begins with its word (fanfare8.wav counts)
A hit's sound plays on the device that takes it -- the knockout on the one knocked out, poison on the one poisoned, the crit on the one hit -- not on the attacker's
The fanfare, the crit, the poison and the knockout all go through the same bindings
